answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through radio time-difference-of-arrival attestation. Each node timestamps an ultra-wideband signal emitted by a synchronized ground beacon using a dedicated oscillator. Attackers must provision discrete, spatially separated radio receivers and timing hardware per identity to synthesize plausible arrival deltas. However, multipath scattering from obstacles or an overhead raven can distort pulse propagation, causing false rejections.
